svg.text: Beam: RHS 100 x 50 x 4 mm, 1,400 mm long, the 100 mm side upright.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fork plates: 8 mm, 120 x 100 mm, two per wheel, 600 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the middle, hanging under the beam, 3 mm clear of each wheel face;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 21 mm axle holes 70 mm below the beam. Inner truck: forks 70 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart for the wide-groove wheels; outer truck: 50 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seats: 10 mm plate 150 x 160 mm on top, 560 mm each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle, four 14 mm holes outside the beam for the truss feet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Derailment guards: 6 mm plate 160 x 160 mm either side of the track,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 24 mm clear of the channel, bottom edge 30 mm above the wall top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shaft hole: 32 mm through both walls, 380 mm right of the middle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 mm up from the beam bottom. Rubber buffers on both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outer truck only: 500 x 240 x 4 mm chequer step on two brackets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the four axle holes lie square and level within 1 mm.
